title: Split runtime policy config into per-policy modules before AstrBot platform_settings parity grows
description: Runtime policy_config.rs is still the single DTO/conversion point for wake, whitelist, session status, rate limit, content safety, provider fallback, result decoration, and restart state. AstrBot platform_settings is much broader, so split this before adding segmented reply, permissions, platform-specific policy, or richer safety config.

files.change: Re-export public runtime policy config DTOs.
Move current policy DTOs and From conversions by behavior area.

criteria: Runtime policy public re-exports remain compatible.
Schema/UI metadata imports continue to compile without reaching into unrelated policy modules.
No new policy behavior is added.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-runtime && cargo clippy -p astrbot-runtime -- -D warnings
